description: This repository provides an EPANET WSN1 input network, a compressed four-day hydraulic report and notebooks that generate a thirty-day trace for testing surrogate models. The README describes Water Sensor Network 1 as having one reservoir, two pump stations, two tanks and about 23 miles of pipe. The primary notebook drives EPANET at fifteen-minute steps and adds demand-pattern jitter; the comparison notebook parses a half-hourly 96-hour report. The authors compare tree, neural and additive models for prediction and interpretation, with code under MIT and a request to credit the original WSN1 benchmark. Coverage is a benchmark network and synthetic hydraulic experiments, not measurements from an operating utility. The repository warns that notebook paths reflect an author working tree and may need correction after cloning. A modeller can adapt the EPANET network and compare predictive-control surrogates; transfer to a live system has not been established. It complements data-uky-water-distribution-system-research-database with a specific augmented WSN1 experiment. No notebook, report archive or model was run. A caveat for simulation use is that the resulting surrogate predictions have no demonstrated validity on a live water utility.
